title: My Oh My Mississippi Meatballs
description: A delicious and easy way to elevate frozen meatballs using a crock pot, pepperoncini, and savory seasoning packets.

ingredients.item: big bag of frozen homestyle meatballs

steps: Drop a big bag of frozen homestyle meatballs in a crock pot.
In a separate container, whisk together water, pepperoncini juice, au jus mix, and ranch seasoning until beautifully combined.
Pour the mixture over the meatballs and give them a quick stir.
Cut the stick of unsalted butter into pats and place them on top of the meatballs.
Add as many pepperoncinis as you want to the crock pot.
Put the lid on and set the crock pot to low for three hours.
When the time is up, take the lid off and give it one more quick stir before serving.
notes:
The author suggests serving these over pasta, in a hoagie roll, or as an appetizer. They also recommend stirring occasionally during the cooking process.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1NzMb8pey3/

Au jus and ranch packets add a lot more sodium.
A whole stick of butter adds saturated fat.
